metadata.description: Git-authoritative development tooling for Claude Code: the sbrain workflow plugin, its NestJS backend stack profile, and its Vue admin-dashboard frontend stack profile.

plugins.name: sbrain
plugins.description: Git-authoritative development kernel: session boot/close protocols, task ledger with generated index, layered memory, deterministic enforcement hooks (pnpm-only, protected branches), fresh-context code reviewer, worktree-based parallel task dispatch, bootstrap interview, a NestJS backend stack profile (LDAP/breakglass auth, MinIO storage, RBAC), and a Vue 3 admin-dashboard frontend stack profile (Tailwind + shadcn-vue via MCP, wired in by bootstrap).
